def project_simplex(v, S):
    """Project to simplex with L1 normalization."""
    v = np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64)
    w = np.sort(v)[::-1]
    cumsum = np.cumsum(w)
    idx = np.arange(1, len(v)+1, dtype=np.float64)
    theta_candidates = (cumsum - S) / idx
    if not np.any(theta_candidates <= w).any():

    else:
        rho = np.max(np.where(theta_candidates <= w)[0]) + 1
    theta = (cumsum[rho-1] - S) / rho
    return np.maximum(v - theta, 0)
